name: 11204 · Brooklyn, NY
findings: ZIP 11204 (Brooklyn) has 728 nonprofit organizations. 79 of them (11%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 66 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (49% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11204 (Brooklyn) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
